paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets.
model_annotation: The pie chart displays the distribution of data sources in a combined training set. The chart comprises 13 slices, representing various data sources. The labels and approximate percentages for each slice are as follows: NQ (31.3%, blue), FEVE (16.1%, light blue), SNLI (15.4%, orange), VITAMINC (13%, light green), MULTINLI (11.3%, red), ANLI (4.6%, yellow), FACTCC (2.6%, green), ENTFA (1.8%, dark green), XSUMHUL (1.6%, gray), SCITAIL (1.2%, brown), PUBHEALTH (0.5%, light brown), MULTIFC (0.5%, dark brown), and SCIFACT (0.1%, dark blue). A legend is not present, but percentage labels are shown inside or next to each slice; no slices appear visually emphasized. The segments are not ordered in a specific, discernible pattern.
